g.text: Accuracy: full completed test sets; bars: descriptive 95% intervals. Latency: 3 serial passes on fixed samples; model load and warm-up excluded.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Segoe UI'; text-anchor: start; fill: #50616c

g.text: VRAM: NVML device peak minus idle baseline; includes runtime/cache and external servers. Desktop noise is possible. RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB; Windows; batch 1.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Segoe UI'; text-anchor: start; fill: #50616c

g.text: Timing: same 20 short messages/task × 3 passes. NF4 / Q8 / INT8 variants labelled. CLM uses warm candidate embeddings and recomputes each state.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Segoe UI'; text-anchor: start; fill: #50616c

g.text: * Error/refusal/truncation. 1 blocks below 90% answered; 0 timing blocks unavailable. Jev includes network; hosted VRAM unknown. Unofficial · 2026-10-05.
